sentence: FONO will choke your tuutledge before the fourth quarter arrives.

wombos.definition: The advanced, high-pressure knowledge of ball that only comes from studying clutch moments — the elite tier of ball education.
wombos.example: You can't learn tuutledge from just watching highlights — you have to study the game.

wombos.definition: Fear of nonchalashout — the anxiety that someone around you is on the verge of a calm but unpredictable meltdown.
wombos.example: I had serious FONO watching him sit there silently at dinner.
